d:
Hi!

Starting with this book I'm making my own translations, even for works that have been already translated. They won't be as nuanced and precise as the work of other people that does it professionally, but I think it's the only way the gallery won't be expunged or inaccessible (it seems 4 of the last ones I uploaded are inaccessible now here). Sorry in advance for any mistakes.

Thanks so much to Kuroinu Guanguan for the scans and especially to Kuroinu Juu for his amazing work.

So the title. 魔魅 Mami would be a bewitching spirit, but also a female name related to beauty and written in a lot of ways. And ダラ Dara, which is gitaigo for some thick liquid oozing or dripping constantly. Then Mamidara would be something like a cum-oozing, charming spirit/goddess? It's kinda fun.

And now, the monsters names. Not 100% sure, but at least the last one I think is a reference to an illustrated book called "Waniwani no gochisō". The english edition goes for "Alliethegator's feast" or something like that. So I went for Alliethegator instead of Crocodile or aligator. Dunno if the other monster's names are also references or if I'm just reading too much into it.

Anyway, this took so much more work and time than usual. Hope you like it. Have fun and see ya all later =D.
n: [Doujinshi] [BLACK DOG (Kuroinu Juu)] Mami no Meikyuu 2 Leskko Boukensha Hen - Mamidara's Dungeon 2 Lesbian adventurers episode [Digital]
